title: GSTR-2B vs Books Reconciliation: Securing 100% Legitimate Input Tax Credit
summary: Procedural steps for resolving GSTR 2B 3B ITC mismatches under Rule 36(4) and defending against DRC-01A and Section 73 discrepancy notices.
body:
Systematic monthly matching between auto-drafted GSTR-2B statements and GSTR-3B filings is mandatory to protect your business against DRC-01 notices and interest penalties.

Track upcoming statutory cutoffs on our [GST filing deadlines and due dates](/compliance) page, or visit [our Kolkata & Salt Lake desk](/locations/kolkata-metro) for automated ITC matching support.

Identifying mismatched purchase ledgers prior to departmental scrutiny ensures full ITC eligibility. If you have received a reconciliation discrepancy notice, [schedule a consultation](/schedule) for legal defense.
